title: ECHA SVHC Candidate List cache
description: Snapshot of the ECHA SVHC Candidate List for REACH Article 33 compliance checks. Production refreshes this file on a schedule from echa.europa.eu/candidate-list-table. The source URL and snapshot_date travel through every compliance_check tool response so consumers can audit provenance.

source.description: URL of the official ECHA Candidate List page.

snapshot_date.description: ISO 8601 date this snapshot was taken from ECHA.

reason_for_inclusion.description: Brief reason ECHA listed the substance (carcinogenic, PBT, toxic for reproduction, etc.).

date_added.description: ISO 8601 date ECHA added the substance to the Candidate List.
